main_text.head: In Centum Distocha Heroica a Generoso Juuene D. Venceslao M. à Zaltrifel, Morauo, conscripta.

p.i: Quem Musa iuuenem tanto amplectitur amore
Quatus erit quado ingenio par venerit atas?
Nempe admiretur merito quem patria tantum,
Venceslae, tuum quod BEZA & Iperat & optat.

main_text.head: In Lamentationes Ieremiæ Versibus Lyricis à IOANNE IACOMOTO BARRENSI expressas.

p.i: Vas strata lacrymas diuino carmine fudit
Cur, age, sic renouans nobis, Iacomote, sonora
Nempe isti similes quod poenas crimina nobis
Et quem non cura ista coquit, nisi qualis in orbe
Ast utinam sancti clamore excita Prophetæ,
Illa Sion nostro, quam condere tempore capit

page.notes: Verse lines are printed as one paragraph per stanza; some Greek words, e.g. "Iperat" and "Gnus", are uncertain. Ornamental rules and small decorative marks between sections are omitted. The first heading and the Lamentationes heading are printed in larger type and are treated as level 2 titles.
